situations.title: 절개 전 초기 계수
situations.tagline: Let's get the initial count done before the incision.
situations.brief: 절개 전 거즈와 기구, 바늘의 초기 계수를 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm starting the initial count now.
Let's count sponges, instruments, and needles together.
The baseline count is recorded before we begin.

situations.title: 거즈 소리내어 확인
situations.tagline: Can we count these sponges out loud together?
situations.brief: 거즈 계수를 소리내어 구두로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's count these out loud, one by one.
I count ten sponges — can you confirm?
We say each number together as we go.

situations.title: 기구 목록 대조
situations.tagline: I need to match every instrument against the tray list.
situations.brief: 기구를 목록과 하나씩 대조해 계수하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check each instrument against the count sheet.
Every item on the tray needs to match the list.
I'll confirm the totals with you.

situations.title: 바늘 회수 확인
situations.tagline: How many needles do we have back on the counter?
situations.brief: 사용한 바늘을 회수해 계수로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's account for every needle we've used.
All needles go back on the magnet for counting.
I count each one before we move on.

situations.title: 계수 기록 작성
situations.tagline: I'll document the count on the board and the record.
situations.brief: 계수 결과를 기록판과 기록지에 문서화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm writing the counts on the board now.
Each count is documented with the time.
The record shows all totals match.

situations.title: 봉합 전 계수 개시
situations.tagline: We're getting ready to close — let's start the closing count.
situations.brief: 봉합 전 시점에 맞춰 closing count를 개시하세요.
keyPhrases: Before we close, I'm starting the closing count.
Let's verify everything before the cavity is closed.
All counts need to match before closure.

situations.title: 추가 거즈 투입 기록
situations.tagline: I'm adding ten more sponges to the field — please log them.
situations.brief: 추가로 투입한 거즈를 계수에 반영해 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: Ten additional sponges added — updating the count.
Let me log these before they go into the field.
Our new total includes the extra sponges.

situations.title: 계수 중 교대 인계
situations.tagline: I'm relieving you — walk me through where the count stands.
situations.brief: 계수 도중 교대할 때 계수 연속성이 유지되도록 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's do a full count together before I take over.
Show me the current totals so nothing is lost.
We recount to confirm before the handover.
goals: 교대 시 현재 계수를 함께 확인한다

situations.title: 방사선 표지 거즈 확인
situations.tagline: Are all these sponges the X-ray detectable kind?
situations.brief: 사용 거즈가 X선 불투과 표지가 있는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Only X-ray detectable sponges go on this field.
Let me confirm each one has the radiopaque marker.
No non-detectable sponges near the wound.
goals: 거즈에 X선 불투과 표지가 있는지 확인한다

situations.title: 기구 분해 부품 계수
situations.tagline: This retractor comes apart — we need to count each piece.
situations.brief: 분해되는 기구는 부품 단위로 계수하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's count each component of this instrument.
All the small parts need to be accounted for.
The set has three pieces — I confirm all three.

situations.title: 소독포 안 잔류 확인
situations.tagline: Check the drapes — a sponge might be tucked in a fold.
situations.brief: 소독포 접힌 부분에 물품 잔류가 없는지 필드를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's search the drape folds for anything hidden.
Shake out the drapes before we finalize the count.
Nothing should be left in the folds.

situations.title: 바늘 파손 조각 확인
situations.tagline: The needle snapped — we have to find both pieces.
situations.brief: 바늘이 파손되면 조각을 모두 회수했는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: The needle broke — we need every fragment back.
Let's account for both halves before closing.
I'll search the field until all pieces are found.

situations.title: 계수 방해 응급 상황
situations.tagline: We had to move fast — where were we in the count?
situations.brief: 응급 상황으로 계수가 중단된 뒤 재개해 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Once things settle, we restart the count from a known point.
Let's recount everything to be safe.
I'll document that the count was interrupted.

situations.title: 두 명 동시 계수
situations.tagline: Let's do this as a dual count — you say it, I confirm it.
situations.brief: 두 명이 함께 dual count로 동시에 계수하세요.
keyPhrases: We count together — both of us see each item.
You count aloud and I'll verify.
A dual count means we both confirm the total.

situations.title: 전자 계수 병행
situations.tagline: We're scanning each sponge into the system as we count.
situations.brief: 전산 계수 시스템을 수기 계수와 병행해 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Each sponge gets scanned and manually counted.
The electronic system should match our manual total.
Let's reconcile the scan count with the board.

situations.title: 봉합 직전 거즈 불일치
situations.tagline: Stop — my sponge count is off by one, we can't close.
situations.brief: 봉합 직전 거즈 계수 불일치를 발견하면 count discrepancy를 선언하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm declaring a count discrepancy — hold closure.
We're one sponge short, we need to search now.
No closing until the count reconciles.

situations.title: X선 잔류 거즈 확인
situations.tagline: The count's still off — we need an intraop X-ray now.
situations.brief: 잔류 이물이 의심되면 X선 영상으로 잔류 거즈를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's get an X-ray before we close.
We image the field to rule out a retained sponge.
Radiology needs to confirm nothing's left inside.

situations.title: 소실 바늘 필드 수색
situations.tagline: One needle is missing — everyone, we search the field now.
situations.brief: 소실된 바늘을 필드에서 체계적으로 수색하세요.
keyPhrases: We're one needle short — hold everything.
Let's search the field, drapes, and floor systematically.
Nobody moves until we find it.

situations.title: 봉합 후 계수 오류
situations.tagline: We closed, but the final count doesn't add up — what do we do?
situations.brief: 봉합 후 계수 오류가 확인되면 재개방 여부를 판단하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The final count is wrong — we may need to reopen.
Let's image before deciding on re-exploration.
I'm escalating this to the surgeon immediately.

situations.title: 이물 잔류 의심 보고
situations.tagline: I believe an object may be retained — I'm reporting this now.
situations.brief: 이물 잔류가 의심되면 retained object로 즉시 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a possible retained object — I'm documenting it.
We need to file an incident report immediately.
Patient safety comes first — I'm reporting this.

situations.title: 계수 불일치 은폐 압력
situations.tagline: Just let it go — the count's probably fine, we're running late.
situations.brief: 계수 불일치를 은폐하라는 압력에도 정직하게 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I can't ignore a discrepancy — patient safety is first.
We have to document and resolve this properly.
I won't sign off until the count is correct.
